pages.title: Ram Rush
pages.creator: HF Studio
pages.description: Grow strong enough to break barriers in Ram Rush. Switch lanes to hit green numbers, collect meat for an extra point, and avoid spikes that reduce your strength. Red numbers are too large to ram, so use an open lane and survive to extend the score clock.

pages.title: Obby: Tsunami Escape +1 by Car
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drive ahead of an approaching wave in Obby: Tsunami Escape +1 by Car. Avoid the tsunami and race toward the finish while earning improvements for the vehicle. Buy more capable cars and upgrade them to take on tougher escape runs.

pages.title: Mojicon Fruit Connect
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description: Pair emoji tiles in Mojicon Fruit Connect. Find matching designs with a clear connecting route and remove them from the board while handling frozen tiles and shifting gravity. Complete levels to fill the character album and return to the fruit farm for available rewards.

pages.title: Bubble Piggies
pages.creator: Bubble Shooter
pages.description: Release trapped animals in Bubble Piggies. Shoot matching groups of at least three bubbles to free every pig and move the formation down another floor. Work through fifty levels featuring sleeping or hidden pigs, moving bubbles, and power-ups.

pages.title: Blankets
pages.creator: BlackMoon Design
pages.description: Arrange matching fabric pieces in Blankets. Bring together the same colors and patterns to remove them and free space on the board. Plan where the next piece belongs as you build a higher puzzle score.

pages.title: HexaMatch
pages.creator: PixelOre
pages.description: Put numbered tiles in order in HexaMatch. Slide a tile into the board's single empty position, then use the new gap for another move. Keep rearranging the pieces until the numbers form the required sequence.

pages.title: Brainrot Evolution
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Evolve unusual creatures in Brainrot Evolution. Break objects to collect resources and experience, then unlock the next animal form. Add pets for extra advantages while exploring the levels and strengthening the character's destructive abilities.

pages.title: Geometry Platformer
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Guide a changing cube through hazards in Geometry Platformer. Run and jump past spikes, swinging obstacles, and sections that alter gravity. Use WASD and the space bar to navigate the geometric courses and time each landing.

pages.title: My Purrfect Cat Hotel
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Run an animal guesthouse in My Purrfect Cat Hotel. Welcome cats and respond to their needs while organizing the hotel. Work through the management activities to make the lodging a more comfortable place for its visitors.

pages.title: Obby +1 Pet Every Seconds
pages.creator: GeekPlay
pages.description: Build an expanding collection in Obby +1 Pet Every Seconds. Gather the pets that appear each second, merge them into stronger creatures, or sell them for money. Improve the laboratory, market, and house as you open more islands and develop the business.

pages.title: Ball Mania!
pages.creator: Momo Games
pages.description: Steer a small runner along narrow tracks in Ball Mania! Slide left and right to keep the ball on the route, turn through corners, and avoid unexpected obstacles. Reach the end without letting it fall from the course.

pages.title: Word Mine
pages.creator: Thirdeyeverse Technologies Pvt. Ltd
pages.description: Rearrange letters into answers in Word Mine. Drag them around the grid and use the color clues to check their positions. Green confirms a correct placement, yellow indicates the right row or column, and white shows that a letter belongs elsewhere.

pages.title: Brain puzzles-Quests
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Work through varied challenges in Brain puzzles-Quests. Read the instruction for each scene, then click objects, drag pieces, or try another interaction to solve it. Use a hint when a puzzle needs a less obvious approach.

pages.title: Car Stunt Racing 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Compete through hazardous courses in Car Stunt Racing 3D. Move left and right to evade opposing vehicles while collecting money and energy. React to the next turn and keep the car progressing through the race.

pages.title: Race Clicker
pages.creator: Playsaurus Inc.
pages.description: Build racing speed through taps in Race Clicker. Click to push your car's performance, then customize and upgrade it for the next contest. Use the growing capabilities to challenge the other drivers and pursue more wins.

pages.title: Dynamons 6
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Collect a new team of creatures in Dynamons 6. Explore four areas, recruit special Dynamons, and use action cards in turn-based one-on-one battles. Learn from Jovani and combine attacks with power-ups to overcome rival teams.

pages.title: Eco Recycler
pages.creator: Andy Games
pages.description: Turn refuse into products in Eco Recycler. Collect rubbish from the delivery truck and carry it to the recycling station. Move the resulting crates to production equipment, then sell the finished goods to continue the operation.

pages.title: Gravity Glide
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Work through physics-driven courses in Gravity Glide. Time your movement around fast obstacles, zigzagging sections, and high-jump challenges. Use the arrow keys to navigate the hazards and keep the attempt going.

pages.title: Spring Haute Couture Season 1
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Style celebrity models in Spring Haute Couture Season 1. Browse the wardrobes for clothing suited to the fashion event and choose an individual hairstyle for each girl. Coordinate the available pieces into complete runway looks.

pages.title: Just Tower Jump?
pages.creator: EMPTY_FIELD
pages.description: Keep climbing a collapsing structure in Just Tower Jump? Move between the left and right sides to reach higher platforms without falling. Complete stunts for rewards, increase the character's level, and build prestige to improve the tower.

pages.title: Bffs Fall Fashion Trends
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Create layered autumn looks in Bffs Fall Fashion Trends. Choose clothing for the friends from the seasonal wardrobe and combine the pieces into outfits. Experiment with the heavier-weather styles to give each girl a different appearance.

pages.title: Robo Exit
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Guide a robot to the door in Robo Exit. Run, jump, and slide along walls while gathering coins and avoiding the level's traps. Use mouse or touch controls to time the movements that carry it toward the exit.

pages.title: Crowd Stack 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Gather a larger group in Crowd Stack 3D. Add companions along the course so more characters can tackle the obstacles together. Collect diamonds during the run and spend them on additional skins.

pages.title: Roll Sky Ball 3D
pages.creator: PL Studio
pages.description: Roll toward the finish in Roll Sky Ball 3D. Slide and hold to steer the ball through changing track layouts and obstacles. Keep watching the next stretch so your movement carries it safely to the goal.

pages.title: Air Strike - War Plane Simulator
pages.creator: Bermuda Games
pages.description: Engage hostile aircraft in Air Strike - War Plane Simulator. Use the mouse to aim at enemy jets and hold the cursor over the target to attack. Keep tracking opponents through the three-dimensional air battles.

pages.title: Crazy Tunnel 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Avoid barriers inside a curved course in Crazy Tunnel 3D. Move sideways with the left and right controls, and hold the up key to jump before releasing it to land. Work through the gaps and unlock other orbit styles as you continue.

pages.title: Magic Forest Tiles Puzzle
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Clear an enchanted board in Magic Forest Tiles Puzzle. Connect identical pairs through a route containing no more than three straight segments. Remove every pair before the timer ends to finish the level.

pages.title: Yarn Untangled
pages.creator: Salt Pastel Studio
pages.description: Separate crossing strands in Yarn Untangled. Drag the balls of wool into different positions until the connecting yarn no longer tangles. Work through the changing arrangements with the accompanying cats and keep every strand's route in view.

pages.title: Laser Cannon 3
pages.creator: HyperCarrot
pages.description: Eliminate creatures with careful shots in Laser Cannon 3. Aim the cannon around each physics puzzle and use the environment to reach awkward targets. Clear every monster while trying to spend fewer shots on the level.

pages.title: Rescue The Woman
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Free a kidnapped dancer in Rescue The Woman. Search the area while the guards are away and find the key that opens her prison. Solve the quiet escape task without confronting the criminals directly.

pages.title: Dots
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Join colored pieces in Dots. Connect equal-colored dots through horizontal or vertical neighbors to add points. Choose among four modes and keep finding groups that help improve your total.

pages.title: Squid Battle Simulator
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Command competing forces in Squid Battle Simulator. Place soldiers and other character types on the field, then observe their attacks against the enemy army. Arrange the available units and use the watching doll's abilities to overcome the opposition.

pages.title: Christmas 2021 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble nine seasonal scenes in Christmas 2021 Puzzle. Choose an image and a 16-, 36-, 64-, or 100-piece arrangement. Reconstruct the picture by matching the scattered shapes and Christmas details.

pages.title: Chess Move 2
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Reach the opposing king in Chess Move 2. Select a piece to see its legal destinations and plan a route through twenty-four puzzle levels. Move board sections or use gravity switches when the standard paths cannot reach the red king.

pages.title: Princess Kawaii Swimwear
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Choose beach outfits in Princess Kawaii Swimwear. Browse a collection of softly colored swimsuits and create a look for each princess. Try the different available pieces as the girls prepare to relax by the water.

pages.title: New Year Puddings Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Collect requested sweets in New Year Puddings Match. Swap neighboring blocks to form horizontal or vertical groups of at least three matching candies. Meet the specified collection total in each level to move to the next festive board.

pages.title: Kpop Adventure
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Prepare singers for the stage in Kpop Adventure. Choose outfits, accessories, and vivid makeup for the idols before their performance. Coordinate the different styling pieces to create a finished look for each performer.

pages.title: Sweet Candy Hexa Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Complete hexagonal lines in Sweet Candy Hexa Puzzle. Drag shaped block groups onto the board and fit them together without wasting space. Full lines disappear and add points, leaving room for further placements.

pages.title: my puzzle
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Put an image back together in my puzzle. Move the supplied pieces into their matching positions and complete the picture. Examine their shapes and visual details to find where the remaining parts belong.

pages.title: Shoot Your Nightmare: The Beginning
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search a nightmare for twelve clocks in Shoot Your Nightmare: The Beginning. Explore the hostile dream, gather the items needed to wake up, and shoot the threats blocking your progress. Change weapons and keep moving through the dark environment.

pages.title: Flat Jumper 2
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Jump between colored platforms in Flat Jumper 2. Move the ball with the arrow keys and change its color with the space bar to match the next landing. Use the touch buttons for the same movement and color choices on a touch screen.

pages.title: Release The Gift Boxes
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Build a stack of presents in Release The Gift Boxes. Tap the gift hanging from the grabber to drop it onto the pile. Time the release so it lands centrally and the growing tower stays off the floor.

pages.title: Animals Puzzle
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Reassemble four cheerful pictures in Animals Puzzle. Drag the scattered parts into position over the visible background image. Use that reference to match each animal detail and complete the chosen scene.

pages.title: The Archer
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Shoot floating targets in The Archer. Aim arrows at balloons to earn points, extra ammunition, and lives while avoiding bombs that end the game. Collect cash during the challenge to purchase more arrows.

pages.title: Lego Block Puzzle
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Fill a grid with construction-brick shapes in Lego Block Puzzle. Place the offered pieces to complete entire rows or columns and remove them. Keep room for another shape while building a higher score.

pages.title: Polygon Drift: Endless Traffic Racing
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Drift through ordinary road traffic in Polygon Drift: Endless Traffic Racing. Choose among six cars and two routes with different weather, then steer through the drive. Any collision with a vehicle or obstacle ends the attempt and requires a restart.

pages.title: Unroll It
pages.creator: CD GAMES
pages.description: Create a rolling route in Unroll It. Slide the grooved blocks until their channels form a continuous path from the metal ball to the red goal. Check how each moved section changes the remaining connections.

pages.title: Super Jet Ski Race Stunt : Water Boat Racing 2020
pages.creator: Pixel Studio
pages.description: Compete on the water in Super Jet Ski Race Stunt : Water Boat Racing 2020. Choose a watercraft and adjust its engine setup before entering the race. Try the available modes and work through the boating challenges with your selected ride.

pages.title: Kissing Test
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Try a playful novelty result in Kissing Test. Select a gender and interact with the on-screen lips to receive the game's kissing-style label. Treat the displayed result as part of the entertainment activity rather than a measurement of a real skill.

pages.title: Cute Whale Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Put together a marine picture in Cute Whale Jigsaw. Select an image and a puzzle mode before the pieces scatter. Drag matching sections into place to restore the full whale illustration.

pages.title: Fly House
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Protect an airborne home in Fly House. Use mouse or touch controls to guide it around the obstacles interrupting its journey. Keep the house traveling for as long as possible, then compare the attempt's result on the scoreboard.

pages.title: Draw Leg
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Design movement for a runner in Draw Leg. Sketch legs that can carry the character over the next obstacle, then redraw them when the terrain changes. Adjust each pair's shape to keep moving through the course and win the race.

pages.title: Outer Space Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Pair cosmic pictures in Outer Space Memory. Reveal the cards and remember where each design appears to locate its matching partner. Clear four increasingly difficult levels before the available time expires.

pages.title: Sweet Fruit Candy
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Collect matching produce in Sweet Fruit Candy. Connect groups of the same fruit to remove them and complete the current challenge. Use mouse or swipe controls to select useful groups as you work through the puzzle stages.

pages.title: Free Fall 3D
pages.creator: Parrot Games
pages.description: Steer through a falling course in Free Fall 3D. Use the arrow keys to move around obstacles while the character descends. React to approaching barriers and keep the attempt going to build a higher result.

pages.title: Color Lines Deluxe
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Arrange matching balls in Color Lines Deluxe. Move colors together into lines to remove them and make room on the board. Keep useful routes open between empty spaces while planning the next clearing combination.

pages.title: Bigfoot Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Slide truck-picture tiles in Bigfoot Slide. Choose among three images and three puzzle modes, then rearrange the scrambled sections. Follow the vehicle and background details to restore the complete picture.

pages.title: Pickup Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Handle a truck in Pickup Simulator. Complete parking assignments or drive freely around the mountain environment. Use WASD or the arrow keys to steer, the space bar for the handbrake, and C to change the view.

pages.title: Offroad Jeep Simulator
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Explore off-road driving in Offroad Jeep Simulator. Pick a jeep and try the available game modes with its different routes and tasks. Control the vehicle with WASD while judging the terrain ahead.

pages.title: Cute Monsters Memory
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find matching creature pictures in Cute Monsters Memory. Flip two tiles at a time and remember where each monster appears. Clear the four boards while trying to finish with fewer guesses.

pages.title: Space Ball
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guide a rolling object through an endless course in Space Ball. Steer with the mouse or arrow keys to move clear of the next obstacle. Keep watching the route ahead and extend the run for as long as possible.

pages.title: Little Coloring Yeti
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Color eight creature drawings in Little Coloring Yeti. Choose an image and apply any shades you want to its outlined details. Use the camera button to download the completed yeti picture.

pages.title: Transport Sea Animal
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Deliver marine wildlife in Transport Sea Animal. Drive a large truck from the beach toward the aquarium along steep roads and sharp bends. Use the brake and camera controls to judge difficult sections while keeping the transport on course.

pages.title: Party Pixel Apocalypse
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fight through block-style arenas in Party Pixel Apocalypse. Join team deathmatches, free-for-all battles, or zombie mode, using keyboard movement and mouse aiming. Team up, chat, or create a server to choose the kind of firefight you want.

pages.title: Wood Block Puzzle
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Clear wooden shapes in Wood Block Puzzle. Place blocks into the grid to complete lines and remove them for points. Plan which gaps to fill so the next group of pieces still has room to fit.

pages.title: Tractor Towing Train
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pull railway vehicles with a farm machine in Tractor Towing Train. Use WASD to guide the tractor and bring the attached load through each level. Switch cameras with C when another angle helps you judge the route.

pages.title: The Island Survival Challenge
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Explore a remote environment in The Island Survival Challenge. Walk around, interact with objects, and manage the items in the inventory as you work on surviving the island. Use E for interactions and the inventory keys to check your supplies.

pages.title: Planet Attack Clicker
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Damage worlds through repeated taps in Planet Attack Clicker. Click the planet to continue the attack and build your progress. Buy upgrades to strengthen the effect and keep the endless clicker activity moving.

pages.title: Army of Soldiers Resistance
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Command two defenders in Army of Soldiers Resistance. Use the team's weapons to stop creatures invading from another world before they reach the base. Keep both soldiers fighting through the assault to protect the position.

pages.title: Color Rash
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Destroy colored vortices in Color Rash. Fire the matching color to clear each target without making a wrong-color shot. Collect diamonds, buy new ships, and continue through the levels while improving your score.

pages.title: Sweet Valentine Pets Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Unlock ten romantic animal pictures in Sweet Valentine Pets Jigsaw. Finish the first puzzle to earn in-game money, then buy another image. Choose among three difficulties, with the harder layouts providing larger rewards.

pages.title: Boxes Physic
pages.creator: Game-Game.com.ua
pages.description: Trigger falling chain reactions in Boxes Physic. Destroy a block so the resulting pieces strike and break others below it. Clear every intact shape from the screen as quickly as possible to finish the physics puzzle.

pages.title: Pixel gun apocalypse 6
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Enter block-world firefights in Pixel gun apocalypse 6. Fight as or against soldiers and zombies in the multiplayer first-person arenas. Move through the map with your weapon ready and take on the opposing side.

pages.title: Fire Blocks
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Shoot away a block formation in Fire Blocks. Time your firing around moving barriers so projectiles can reach the targets. Keep clearing the stack while waiting for another safe opening when an obstacle passes across the shot.

pages.title: Mermaid Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help a couple enjoy their date in Mermaid Sauna Flirting. Prepare the mermaid, join the prince in the sauna, and choose interactions that bring them closer. After the flirting activities, select an outfit to finish her look.

pages.title: Dinosaur Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Create a prehistoric picture in Dinosaur Coloring Book. Select a dinosaur illustration and use the brush to fill its outlined sections. Try your own color combinations to finish the chosen artwork.

pages.title: Lemony Girls At Prom
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare Mia and Ellie for Lemony Girls At Prom. Choose yellow-themed outfits that match the event, then add coordinating accessories. Style each princess separately before they leave for the dance.

pages.title: Slenderman History WWII Faceless Horror
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Search a wartime base in Slenderman History WWII Faceless Horror. Find the hidden bunker and retrieve two cases containing documents about the enemy's experiments. Use weapons to confront the fictional supernatural threats encountered during the mission.

pages.title: Jungle Adventure
pages.creator: Solstice Games
pages.description: Travel through dangerous woodland in Jungle Adventure. Guide the hero around threats while collecting jewels along the route. Keep moving through the journey and watch for the next obstacle ahead.

pages.title: Color Tunnel
pages.creator: Royale Gamers
pages.description: Dodge barriers at speed in Color Tunnel. Shift left or right inside the passage to line up with gaps in the approaching shapes. Use A and D or the arrow keys to steer and the space bar to pause or restart.

pages.title: Ultimate Boxing Game
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Trade blows in Ultimate Boxing Game. Face the other boxer in the ring and swipe to throw punches toward your opponent. Time the attacks to connect during the three-dimensional fight.

pages.title: Shimmer and Shine Hidden Stars
pages.creator: GRYDLADZIECI 24.PL
pages.description: Search three scenes in Shimmer and Shine Hidden Stars. Examine pictures featuring the two genies and their friends, then select the stars concealed among the details. Continue looking until every hidden star has been found.

pages.title: Arctic Fruits
pages.creator: Playcombo
pages.description: Help Bobby collect frozen produce in Arctic Fruits. Make matches of at least three identical fruits to clear groups from the board. Work through the puzzles with the penguin and his friends.

pages.title: BFF Princesses Cocktail Party
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Prepare Cinderella for a gathering in BFF Princesses Cocktail Party. Choose a summer outfit from dresses, tops, shorts, and other wardrobe pieces. Put the look together before her fashion-conscious friends arrive for the celebration.

pages.title: Euro Football Pong 2016
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Defend and attack in Euro Football Pong 2016. Position the team to block the opponent's ball, then send it forward to score. Use the mouse to control the forward and backward movement during the contest.

pages.title: Magic Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Serve unusual drinks in Magic Bar. Check the customers' requests and combine ingredients to prepare the required potions. Work through the orders behind the counter and use the recipes to choose the next mixture.

pages.title: Tris Gangsta Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Create a street-inspired party look in Tris Gangsta Dolly Dress Up H5. Open fashion boxes for tops, bottoms, and bold accessories, then combine the pieces into an outfit. Aim for five stars, unlock achievements, and save a picture of your favorite result.
